ideas.level: MS: SPCX + TSLA converging into one physical-AI stack
ideas.summary: Cites Morgan Stanley saying $SPCX and $TSLA are converging into one physical-AI stack (build/power/connect/instrument), with SpaceX supplying compute/connectivity/capital and Tesla robots/data/energy/manufacturing.

ideas.level: AI DC interconnect with LITE/GLW ~10 Tb/s; optics closer to chip
ideas.summary: Notes $QCOM jumping after unveiling an AI data-center interconnect with $LITE and $GLW targeting ~10 Tb/s low-power chip-to-chip bandwidth — framed as optics moving closer to the chip and Qualcomm carving a deeper AI DC role.

ideas.level: Conviction built before the story became obvious; Muse seen as the turning point
ideas.summary: Bullish $META thesis: Muse provides a monetizable consumer-AI product through paid tiers and distribution across Meta apps, reframing capex, AI spend, and the installed base as advantages once price works.

ideas.level: MS: 33 GW US DC power shortfall through 2028; energized sites scarce
ideas.summary: Morgan Stanley sees a 33 GW U.S. data-center power shortfall through 2028 as $NVDA Rubin Ultra pushes rack power toward 600 kW; already-energized sites become more valuable. Names watched: $NBIS, $CRWV, $IREN, $WULF, $CIFR, $APLD, $CORZ.

Running a barbell: cautious ballast in $NVDA (top-two), $TSM, $GOOGL, $META, $AMZN; aggressive asymmetric upside concentrated in $PLTR and $AMD so stability funds staying invested while size sits in movers.

ideas.level: Still long memory via EWY / DRAM; capacity agreements 3–5yr; legacy-memory ASP hikes
ideas.summary: Still long the memory theme through $EWY / $DRAM, citing attractive long-run risk/reward if capacity agreements extend 3–5 years and a potentially interesting legacy-memory trade on ASP hike potential.

ideas.level: Core holding; add on meaningful drawdowns; happy with 2x from here
ideas.summary: Long-cycle bullish on $AMD: treats it as a core holding, plans to add on meaningful drawdowns, and says he would be happy with a 2x from here rather than trading around the position.
$PURR broke above the prior volatility-hole boundary and surged to $14.47; watches $12.80, $11.60, and $9.30 as support.
